therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: PD-L1 checkpoint inhibition combined with VEGF inhibition and chemotherapy
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: Enhanced anti-tumor immunity through checkpoint blockade while inhibiting angiogenesis and directly targeting tumor cells
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Chemotherapy and immunotherapy-naïve patients with stage IV non-squamous non-small cell lung cancer

context.duration: Treatment up to 20 months, follow-up up to 28 months
